description: This Scala source file defines the SchemaConverters object used for converting between Spark SQL schemas and Avro schemas, including handling logical types, recursive structures, and schema options.

classes.name: SchemaType
classes.description: Internal wrapper class for Spark SQL DataType and nullability.

classes.name: IncompatibleSchemaException
classes.description: Exception thrown for schema incompatibility issues.

classes.name: UnsupportedAvroTypeException
classes.description: Exception thrown for unsupported Avro types.

methods.name: toSqlType
methods.description: Converts an Avro schema to a Spark SQL schema with options for stable IDs and recursion depth.

methods.name: toSqlTypeHelper
methods.description: Recursive helper for converting Avro schemas to Spark SQL schemas, handling logical types, recursion, and options.

methods.name: toAvroType
methods.description: Converts a Spark SQL DataType to an Avro Schema, with optional nullability, record name, and namespace.

methods.name: toAvroTypeWithDefaults
methods.description: Converts a Spark SQL StructType to an Avro schema, making all fields nullable and handling nested structures.
